capabilities: Search and filter recipes by ingredients you have
Create or generate a Meal Plan note for each week
Generate shopping lists from recipe ingredients
Download recipes from the internet as Markdown
Parse RecipeMD and heading-based recipe formats
extras: The heading-based recipe format is described as 'to be deprecated' in favor of RecipeMD; shopping list output is customizable via a format string with {property} placeholders.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search recipes by ingredients, plan meals per week, or turn planned recipes into a shopping list.

relations.evidence: This plugin supports two formats of your recipes to extract be able to extract the correct information.

summary: Recipe manager and meal planner that indexes recipe notes, builds weekly meal plan notes, generates shopping lists, and downloads recipes from the web.
